scope: 20 individual product pages; public product specifications, methods and availability. No clinical certification or contractual service claim is implied.
sources: Direct current product HTML and public product-page text. Core PSA, FIT and fertility limitations cross-checked against NHS guidance.
corrections: Fertility: explicitly allow a one-hour semen preparation wait before the five-minute result.
Cholesterol: read after two minutes within the following thirty seconds.
Kidney: urine tip exposure for ten to fifteen seconds, then cap and lay flat; no blood/buffer process.
Iron: one buffer drop, distinct from two for Prostate Health and Vitamin D; Thyroid uses two blood drops and two buffer drops.
Prostate: five minutes is the test reading time, not total collection and testing time.
All supplements: 60 capsules, vegan and one-capsule published daily serving verified; strengths stated without inventing full labels.
General Health Combo includes a multivitamin within the bundle; remove wording implying an optional item inside the advertised pack.
Coming-soon lab panels retain timing to be confirmed; no forty-eight-hour promise.
notClaimed: Partner shipping cut-offs or free delivery are not SHIFT delivery terms.
No supplier accuracy percentages, NHS approval, laboratory accreditation or GP-review entitlement are republished.
No copied promotional claims guaranteeing supplement effects.
